unit: Unit 13: Making Your Computer Easier to Use
title: Bold text
drDigitalIntro:
Bigger is not always clearer. Sometimes what you need is heavier.
• Bold Text thickens every letter on the computer without making anything take up more room.
• It helps most on thin, pale text — the gray helper lines under a setting, for example.
• Try it together with a larger Text Size and see which combination you prefer.
• It is a switch, not a slider: it is either on or off.

steps.say: Click Accessibility in the list on the left.
Click the switch next to Bold Text.

drDigitalSuccess: Every word on the screen just got heavier. Leave it on if you like it.
drDigitalHint: Bold Text sits just under the Text Size slider, in the first card of the Accessibility page.
